## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.zh.md` updated together if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Entry added under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Protocol behavior is backed by the official SIWC documentation (or a recorded observation)
- [ ] No tokens, authorization codes, callback URLs, or credential files in code, tests, or history
